运行时用 eval / new Function 执行字符串代码：模拟器、模板引: Runs code from strings with eval / new Function. Simulators and template engines do this; if the string comes from the network, what runs isn't the code on chain

Temporary wallet {address} holds {amount} {currency}. After the transfer fee, all of it goes back to the holder address {owner}.
The temporary wallet signs the refund itself, so there's nothing to confirm in your wallet.
放弃临时钱包里的零头？: Give up the dust in the temporary wallet?
临时钱包 {address} 里只剩 {amount} {currency}，不:
Temporary wallet {address} only has {amount} {currency} left, which doesn't cover the fee to send it back to {owner}, so it can't be refunded.
Giving it up deletes this temporary wallet, and the funds are lost permanently.
